nodes.label: LayoutLab Build Spec (original vision)
nodes.rationale: The originating product/build spec. It proposed six managers (adding BoxLayout, GridBagLayout, CardLayout, GroupLayout), a Concepts Library, and four Anthropic-API-backed AI features (Live Layout Coach, Diagnose My Mess, AI Reverse Grader, NL-to-layout). The shipped Phase 1 kept the spec's non-negotiable faithful-engine requirement (Section 5) and deterministic code panel (Section 8) but dropped ALL AI: it is LLM-free, ships three managers, and replaced the AI grader with deterministic tree/rectangle graders.
